Meaning that you should be able to have a text/link hybrid, Something that always bugged me about Reddit was that if you wanted to share a link you either had to just make the link be in the text somewhere, or make a link post and make a comment about what you wanted to share about the link, IT would simply be a button that said "Post Hybrid" or similar.

An example argument against this would be the old askreddit rules. If you have a response to your title question, make it a comment so your contribution can be rated equally with the rest of the community. This can help prevent an immediate opinionated response to an article or question. It also allows users to vote differently on the article versus the OP's potential opinion on the topic.

You could always have separated voting buttons for the comment and link, It is a tad annoying just because you can share a link and have the conversation go in a way different place than what the thread was meant to, Or something.

I do see the value in writing an initial text post to accompany the link, for example if you found some contrary sources to a link and want to post them in the immediate text to refute the claims of said article. Possibly having that field have separate up/down votes could be useful. I just worry that having a forced top-level post on any link could contribute to more of a hivemind behavior on various posts.
Or maybe make all posts 'hybrid posts' and make the link and text fields optional. That way, you can submit all kinds of stuff from the same interface.
